POST to https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter: [out:json][timeout:180];(way(BBOX)["highway"];way(BBOX)["man_made"];way(BBOX)["natural"];way(BBOX)["leisure"];way(BBOX)["waterway"];way(BBOX)["landuse"];way(BBOX)["barrier"];way(BBOX)["place"="square"];way(BBOX)["amenity"="parking"];);out geom; plus relation 7333375 (Platja de Sant Sebastia) with member geometry. Overpass rate-limits hard: 3-5 queries in a few minutes returns 504 for a while, so plan ONE pass. Regenerating WILL move the numbers pinned in portvell-benchmark.test.ts -- that is the point of pinning them, but review the diff rather than rubber-stamping it.
